title: Knowledge Graph Evaluation Dashboard (Combined)
description: Merged from `New_dashboard` (graph-level stats) and `Knowledge_Graph_Evaluation_Dashboard_TA_KG_Notebook` (per-ontology evaluation), with audit fixes applied: relationship-type lists restricted to types present in the schema, Typed Relation Ratio redefined as non-structural, Description Completeness scoped to :Concept, Grade Overview duplicate column fix, and historical queries cleaned of broken `n.community` / unprojected-GDS references.

latestCypherQueries.query:
/* Average normalized degree centrality: avg(deg(v) / (|V|-1)) */
MATCH (n)
WITH count(n) AS totalNodes
MATCH (m)
WITH totalNodes, 1.0 * COUNT { (m)--() } / (totalNodes - 1) AS normalizedDegree
RETURN avg(normalizedDegree) AS average_degree_centrality

/* Per-label avg normalized centrality (cleaner: single MATCH, all nodes have exactly one label in this graph) */
MATCH (m)
WITH labels(m)[0] AS labelType, COUNT { (m)--() } AS deg
WITH labelType, avg(deg) AS avgDeg, count(*) AS n
RETURN labelType, avgDeg / (n - 1) AS avg_normalized_centrality
ORDER BY avg_normalized_centrality DESC

/* Raw average degree (not normalized) */
MATCH (n)
WITH n, COUNT { (n)--() } AS degree
RETURN avg(degree) AS average_degree

latestCypherQueries.query:
MATCH (v)
WITH count(v) AS total_nodes
MATCH ()-[e]->()
WITH total_nodes, count(e) AS total_edges
RETURN
    total_nodes,
    total_edges,
    CASE
        WHEN total_nodes > 1
        THEN toFloat(total_edges) / (total_nodes * (total_nodes - 1))
        ELSE 0
    END AS graph_density

/* Modularity via GDS Louvain.
   Run this setup once before the dashboard: CALL gds.graph.project('myGraph', '*', '*'). */
CALL gds.louvain.stats('myGraph')
YIELD modularity
RETURN modularity

/* Project + run Louvain in one go (drops the graph after to keep the catalog clean). */
CALL gds.graph.project('mgTmp', '*', '*') YIELD graphName
WITH graphName
CALL gds.louvain.stats(graphName) YIELD modularity
WITH graphName, modularity
CALL gds.graph.drop(graphName) YIELD graphName AS dropped
RETURN modularity

MATCH (c:Concept)
WITH count(c) AS total,
     sum(CASE WHEN c.materi_pokok_ref IS NOT NULL AND c.materi_pokok_ref <> "" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_ref
RETURN toFloat(has_ref) / total AS MateriPokokCoverage
// Persentase konsep dengan referensi materi pokok (Target: >= 0.80)

MATCH (c:Concept)
WITH count(c) AS total,
     sum(CASE WHEN c.glossary_validated = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validated
RETURN toFloat(validated) / total AS GlossaryValidationRate
// Persentase konsep tervalidasi glosarium (Target: Tinggi)

/* Proporsi relasi semantik vs struktural.
   Struktural = HAS_CHAPTER, HAS_SUBTOPIC, HAS_CONCEPT, NEXT_CHAPTER. */
MATCH ()-[r]->()
WITH count(r) AS total,
     sum(CASE WHEN NOT type(r) IN ['HAS_CHAPTER','HAS_SUBTOPIC','HAS_CONCEPT','NEXT_CHAPTER'] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS typed
RETURN toFloat(typed) / total AS TypedRelationRatio

MATCH ()-[r:PRASYARAT|MEMPERSIAPKAN]->()
RETURN count(r) AS CrossChapterRelations

MATCH (n)
RETURN labels(n)[0] AS Label, count(n) AS Jumlah
ORDER BY Jumlah DESC

MATCH ()-[r]->()
RETURN type(r) AS TipeRelasi, count(r) AS Jumlah
ORDER BY Jumlah DESC
LIMIT 15

MATCH p=(g:Grade)-[:HAS_CHAPTER]->(ch:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(s:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(c:Concept)
RETURN p
LIMIT 500

MATCH (s:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(c:Concept)
RETURN s.name AS Subtopic, count(c) AS JumlahKonsep
ORDER BY JumlahKonsep DESC
LIMIT 20

/* Relationship list restricted to types that exist in the DB schema.
   Includes both spelling variants present in the graph: MENDEFINISIKAN + MEMDEFINISIKAN. */
MATCH p=()-[:MENDEFINISIKAN|MEMDEFINISIKAN|MENYEBABKAN|MEMUNGKINKAN|BAGIAN_DARI|TERDIRI_DARI|BERGANTUNG_PADA|BERINTERAKSI_DENGAN|MENGHASILKAN|MEMPENGARUHI|DIRUMUSKAN_SEBAGAI]->()
RETURN p
LIMIT 150

MATCH (g:Grade)
RETURN g.name AS Grade, g.type AS Type

MATCH p=(:Chapter)-[:NEXT_CHAPTER]->(:Chapter)
RETURN p

MATCH (g:Grade)-[:HAS_CHAPTER]->(c:Chapter)
RETURN g.name AS Grade, count(c) AS JumlahChapter
ORDER BY Grade

MATCH (c:Chapter)
WHERE c.summary IS NOT NULL
RETURN c.name AS Chapter, c.summary AS Summary
ORDER BY c.name

MATCH (c:Concept)
WHERE c.glossary_validated = true
RETURN c.name AS Konsep, c.description AS Deskripsi, c.materi_pokok_ref AS MateriPokok
LIMIT 50

MATCH (c:Concept)
WHERE c.materi_pokok_ref IS NULL OR c.materi_pokok_ref = ""
RETURN c.name AS Konsep, c.description AS Deskripsi
LIMIT 50

/* :ConceptTarget nodes are pure targets — counting all inbound edges yields true reference count
   instead of an arbitrary subset that excluded valid relationship types. */
MATCH (t:ConceptTarget)
RETURN t.name AS TargetName,
       count{(t)<--()} AS ReferenceCount
ORDER BY ReferenceCount DESC
LIMIT 30

MATCH (ch:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(c:Concept)
WITH ch.name AS Chapter, count(c) AS TotalKonsep,
     sum(CASE WHEN c.glossary_validated = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Tervalidasi
RETURN Chapter, TotalKonsep, Tervalidasi,
       toFloat(Tervalidasi) / TotalKonsep AS ValidationRate
ORDER BY ValidationRate DESC
